description: Header file defining the Store2 class implementing various storage interfaces using SQLite, including methods for data management, integrity checks, backup, and configuration within a plugin framework.

classes.name: Store2
classes.description: Implements storage and cache management using SQLite, with support for data operations, integrity checks, backup, and event notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A nested class for dispatching value change notifications asynchronously.

methods.name: TempDirectoryCheck
methods.description: Checks and fixes the journal file directory corruption.

methods.name: IntegrityCheck
methods.description: Performs an integrity check on the SQLite database.

methods.name: Backup
methods.description: Creates a backup of the database, handling corruption scenarios.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the SQLite database and initializes schema with triggers.

methods.name: OnValueChanged
methods.description: Notifies registered clients of a value change.
